alex: Heads-up: proposing a new runtime config 'priority_routing' so console can set per-customer route priorities and weight for quota/throughput. quick sketch below.

alex: ```json
{
  "flag": "priority_routing",
  "type": "object",
  "fields": {
    "priority": "low|normal|high",
    "quota_weight": "int",
    "fail_closed": "bool (default false)"
  }
}
```

jordan: Does this change quota accounting? we must NOT double-count tokens when routing by priority, otherwise teams pay twice.

maria: Console UX idea: add "Snapshot + Approve" flow. admin takes a snapshot that records current traffic baseline, then approves a rollout that references that snapshot. snapshot also pins telemetry baseline.

sam: Rollout safety recs: cohorted % rollout (1%, 5%, 25%, 100%), automatic rollback if any signal trips:
- error_rate delta > 0.5% absolute
- p99 latency > 2x baseline
- quota_breach rate > 1%

alex: API endpoints (early draft):
POST /runtime/configs/{id}/snapshot -> { snapshot_id }
POST /runtime/configs/{id}/apply?dry_run=true -> returns simulated routing impact
PATCH /runtime/configs/{id} -> update fields

jordan: Telemetry gating: what window? 5m is noisy. recommend 30m sliding window w/ min sample N=5k before auto-rollback triggers. also surface raw sample counts in console.

maria: UX asks:
- show tiny diff (what changed)
- show predicted routing sample size & estimated cost delta (tokens/sec estimate)
- make snapshot immutable and visible in audit log
- allow manual hold at each cohort step

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy started for priority-routing v1 -> pool-gamma :thumbsup:

sam: operational concern: cache/KV invalidation. changing priority may require evicting or adjusting KV-cache weights; need plan for gradual invalidation to avoid thundering herd.

alex: Agree. we'll add a 'kv_eviction_plan' field to snapshot metadata. also adding 'fallback_route' default to cost-tier if routing fails.

jordan: Security: restrict ability to set priority=high to org-admin + runtime-admin. add RBAC check in console + API. also audit log entries per change.

maria: DevEx ask: provide an opt-in preview mode for customers (read-only): they can see routing decisions for a small % of requests without affecting billing.

sam: One more: metrics contract for rollout signals. propose we track:
- p95 latency per model & route
- overall error rate (5xx + model errors)
- quota breach count and percent of requests rate-limited
- route divergence percent (how many requests took different paths vs baseline)

alex: Action items:
- alex -> write API spec + example payloads (RFC)
- jordan -> propose telemetry gating thresholds & sampling window
- sam -> KV invalidation + cache plan
- maria -> console mockups for Snapshot + Approve + hold points

maria: schedule quick sync Wed 09:00 PT to triage scope.

alex: cool. after RFC we can ship a dry_run preview + UX and run a 1% controlled experiment. thanks all. :eyes:
